# AI Trail Tracker — Spec Lite

A web application that lets engineers track their progress through the four-level AI Trail badge program (Greenhorn → Wayfinder → Trail Guide → Pioneer) by viewing level-specific activities and training links, submitting evidence URLs for exit criteria, and requesting admin review for badge advancement. An admin dashboard enables Trail leadership to review submissions, approve or reject evidence per criterion, advance developers to the next badge level, and monitor aggregate program progress toward the 100% Wayfinder goal.
